description: Folder-scan sibling of pyspark_pipeline. Points at a folder of feed configs (JSON or YAML) and emits one Dagster multi_asset per file, with automatic cross-file lineage — when one feed's sink target matches another feed's source, they wire up in the asset graph. Feed shape is a superset of pyspark_pipeline (adds `schedule:` cron + `owners:` + `description:` at the top level, plus the control-flow step types condition / checkpoint / for_each).

outputs.description: One Dagster multi_asset per feed file discovered in `feeds_dir`. Cross-feed edges auto-resolve when a sink target matches an upstream source. Feeds with `schedule:` also emit a ScheduleDefinition.

feeds_dir.label: Feeds Directory
feeds_dir.description: Path to the folder of feed configs (relative to component YAML dir, or absolute).

file_glob.label: File Glob
file_glob.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for feed files.

spark_config.label: Spark Config
spark_config.description: Base SparkConf options applied to every feed. Feed-level `spark_config` overlays.

checkpoint_dir.label: Checkpoint Dir
checkpoint_dir.description: Directory for per-feed checkpoint JSON files.

name: PySpark Feed Orchestrator
